startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Product detail URLs (for product_only / product_and_seller) or seller/store URLs (for seller_only).

urlsFile.title: URLs file
urlsFile.description: Optional file with one URL per line (TXT), a column of URLs (CSV) or a JSON array of URLs / `{ "url": ... }` objects. Upload a file or paste a link to one. The URLs are added to Start URLs (duplicates are removed) and follow the same crawl mode.

mode.title: Crawl mode
mode.description: What to capture: 'product_only' scrapes the product; 'product_and_seller' scrapes the product and its seller; 'seller_only' scrapes only the seller from a seller/store URL.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of requests that can be made by this crawler.

enableProxy.title: Use a proxy
enableProxy.description: Whether to route the browser through a proxy. When on, the run uses an Apify residential US exit (fixed in code: DHGate is behind Cloudflare, and that exit gets challenged least while giving each retried session a fresh IP). When off, the run goes out on the container's own IP — expect far more 'Verify you are human' challenges.
